 Serie A official line-ups: Inter vs. Fiorentina 
 By Lorenzo Bettoni 
 Oct 25, 2026 10:26 
 MILAN, ITALY - OCTOBER 10: Marcus Thuram of FC Internazionale Milano controls the ball during the Serie A match between FC Internazionale and Parma Calcio at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on October 10, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Claudio Villa/Getty Images) 
 Ivan Provedel makes his Inter debut in a Serie A match against Fiorentina, with Francesco Pio Esposito and Marcus Thuram starting up front, while the Tuscans look to Mateo Pellegrino.
 It kicks off at 12:30 CET [11:30 GMT] at the Stadio Meazza in San Siro, Milan.
 Follow the build-up and live action on the FOOTBALL ITALIA LIVE BLOG 
 MILAN, ITALY – OCTOBER 13: Marcus Thuram of FC Internazionale Milano clears the ball under pressure from Jan Virgili of Club Brugge KV during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD2 match between FC Internazionale Milano and Club Brugge KV at Stadio San Siro on October 13, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) The Nerazzurri need a win to catch Lazio at the top of the Serie A table after the Biancocelesti beat Parma 2-1 on Saturday night. 
 Inter are without the injured John Stones , Curtis Jones, Lautaro Martinez, Benjamin Pavard and Luis Henrique, while Fiorentina have travelled to Milan without Fabiano Parisi, Arthur Atta and Luca Ranieri.
 Cristian Chivu picks Pio Esposito and Thuram up front, while Andy Diouf returns to the starting XI at right midfield, so Djed Spence starts on the bench.
 MADRID, SPAIN – SEPTEMBER 08: Vinicius Junior of Real Madrid is challenged by Andy Diouf of Internazionale during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD1 match between Real Madrid C.F. and FC Internazionale Milano at Estadio Santiago Bernabeu on September 08, 2026 in Madrid, Spain. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) Ivan Provedel makes his debut in goal, replacing Josep Martinez. Federico Dimarco rests, so Carlos Augusto starts on the left wing. The Brazilian has scored four goals and provided two in eight games across all competitions this season.
 Argentine centre-forward Pellegrino starts up front for the Tuscans, while Marco Brescianini joins Cher Ndour and Nicolò Fagioli in central midfield.
 FLORENCE, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 20: Head coach Paolo Vanoli manager of ACF Fiorentina reacts anf Franco Mastantuono of ACF Fiorentina during the Serie A match between ACF Fiorentina and SSC Napoli at Stadio Artemio Franchi on September 20, 2026 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) Inter remain unbeaten in Serie A this season, with six wins and one draw, and have earned four points so far, though they have lost three of their last five games.
 Inter vs. Fiorentina – official line-ups
 Inter (3-5-2): Provedel; Bisseck, Akanji, Bastoni; Diouf, Barella, Calhanoglu, Mkhitaryan, Carlos Augusto; Thuram, Esposito.
 Fiorentina (4-3-3): De Gea; Jimenez, Dragusin, Pongracic, Valdepenas; Ndour, Fagioli, Brescianini; Mastantuono, Pellegrino, Njie.
